prompt: UI mockup of the bottom of a VS Code chat sidebar panel, dark theme, portrait crop, minimal like Claude Code. The prompt box area is temporarily replaced by a compact permission chooser with the same size as the prompt box: first line in small text "Allow shell command?" and below it in monospace "rm -rf dist". Then a numbered vertical list of three single-line options: "1  Yes" (highlighted row), "2  Yes, always for rm in this project", "3  No, and tell OpenCode what to do instead". Tiny muted hint at the bottom "1-3 or ↑↓ Enter · Esc deny". Crisp readable text.
